title: alert (widget tool input)
description: What the agent sends to the widget tool: the payload without id, rev and producer (the tool sets them); fallback_text optional (the tool writes it); from_file allowed. Something that must not be missed — a failed payment, an outage, a change that affects the person — as a tinted card with what happened and what to do first.

severity.description: info: worth knowing, nothing to do. warning: needs the person soon. critical: broken now, or will be within hours.

headline.description: What happened, one or two sentences: “The card ending 4242 was declined for the DigitalOcean invoice ($38.20).”

impact.description: Who or what it affects, a short phrase for the facts well: “All checkouts”, “Your DigitalOcean server”. Unknown is “Not known yet”, never a guess.

next.description: The one thing to do first, one line: “Update the card in DigitalOcean’s console.” Required for warning and critical.

started_at.description: When it started; shown relative (“18 min ago”) while ongoing.

ended_at.description: When it ended; the Started cell becomes “Lasted 43 min”.

status.description: Incident status, shown in the facts well. resolved removes the tint and turns the badge to ok.

timeline.description: A short timeline, oldest first. Keep the newest five.

acknowledged.description: Someone is on it. Set by the agent in an update.

evidence.description: How it is known: the monitor, the email, the error count. A claim (“Stripe’s status page”) reads “Said by …”.
